```{r libraries}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r importing data and lookup setup}
setwd("~/Desktop/STAT310/final_project/data/preprocessing")
migration_dirty <- read.csv("meta_migration_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) # Facebook/Meta data
codes <- read.csv("alphacodes.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) # Data frame with alpha codes and names

codes$alpha2 <- toupper(codes$alpha2) # Uppercase
encrypt <- codes[,c("alpha2", "en")] # New look up data frame of just alpha codes and country names
```

```{r fixing up country names}
# add missing countries manually to encrypt
missing_countries <- data.frame(
  alpha2 = c("HK", "MO", "TW", "XK"),
  en = c("Hong Kong", "Macao", "Taiwan", "Kosovo"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Clean look up table
encrypt <- rbind(
  codes[, c("alpha2", "en")],
  missing_countries
)

# Fixing names
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Viet Nam"] <- "Vietnam"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Türkiye"] <- "Turkey"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Russian Federation"] <- "Russia"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland"] <- "United Kingdom"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Venezuela, Bolivarian Republic of"] <- "Venezuela"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Bolivia, Plurinational State of"] <- "Bolivia"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Iran (Islamic Republic of)"] <- "Iran"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Korea, Republic of"] <- "South Korea"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Lao People's Democratic Republic"] <- "Laos"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Syrian Arab Republic"] <- "Syria"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Tanzania, United Republic of"] <- "Tanzania"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Congo, Democratic Republic of the"] <- "Democratic Republic of the Congo"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Congo"] <- "Republic of the Congo"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Moldova, Republic of"] <- "Moldova"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Brunei Darussalam"] <- "Brunei"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Bahamas"] <- "The Bahamas"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en == "Gambia"] <- "The Gambia"
encrypt$en[encrypt$en ==  "Micronesia, Federated States of"] <- "Micronesia"
```

```{r regional names preprocessing}
# Creating regions for dashboard
regional <- read_csv("regional.csv")
# Replaces CSV . with spaces 
names(regional) <- gsub("[\\.]", " ", names(regional)) # gsub() applies sub() multiple times

# Wide to Long Data! 
long_regions <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(regional), function(r) { # Loop column names and pull it out
    countries <- regional[[r]]
    countries <- countries[!is.na(countries) & trimws(countries) != ""] # NA/blank spaces removal
    data.frame(
      country = countries,
      region = r,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

# trouble shooting check for missing countries:
# unmatched_from <- migration_dirty[is.na(migration_dirty$region), ]
# unique(unmatched_from$country_from_name)
```

```{r adding country names to migration set}
# lookup vectors
name_lookup <- setNames(encrypt$en, encrypt$alpha2)
continent_lookup <- setNames(encrypt$continent, encrypt$alpha2)
region_lookup <- setNames(long_regions$region, long_regions$country)

# country names
migration_dirty$country_from_name <- name_lookup[migration_dirty$country_from]
migration_dirty$country_to_name   <- name_lookup[migration_dirty$country_to]

# continents
migration_dirty$continent_from <- continent_lookup[migration_dirty$country_from]
migration_dirty$continent_to   <- continent_lookup[migration_dirty$country_to]

# regions (IMPORTANT FIX: use name columns AFTER creating them)
migration_dirty$region_from <- region_lookup[migration_dirty$country_from_name]
migration_dirty$region_to   <- region_lookup[migration_dirty$country_to_name]

# reorder col names
migration_dirty <- migration_dirty[, c(
  "country_from_name",
  "country_to_name",
  "migration_month",
  "num_migrants",
  "country_from",
  "country_to",
  "region_from",
  "region_to", 
  "continent_from",
  "continent_to"
)]

# write.csv(migration_dirty, "clean_migration.csv")
```

```{r missing values from original data}
# View all rows where country_from is NA
migration_dirty %>%
  filter(is.na(country_from)) %>%
  View()  # Opens in RStudio viewer

# Or to see in console
migration_dirty %>%
  filter(is.na(country_from))

# Get a count
migration_dirty %>%
  filter(is.na(country_from)) %>%
  nrow()

# See summary statistics
migration_dirty %>%
  filter(is.na(country_from)) %>%
  summary()

# Check how many NA values in each country column
sum(is.na(migration_dirty$country_from))
sum(is.na(migration_dirty$country_to))

# See which destinations these NA origins are going to
migration_dirty %>%
  filter(is.na(country_from)) %>%
  count(country_to, sort = TRUE)

# See the time range of these NA records
migration_dirty %>%
  filter(is.na(country_from)) %>%
  summarise(
    first_month = min(migration_month),
    last_month = max(migration_month),
    total_migrants = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
